title: Uber's market cap fell to ~$150B, down ~25% in six months, as investors weigh robotaxi disruption, perceiving it as a two-horse race between Waymo and Tesla (Dan Gallagher/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Dan Gallagher / Wall Street Journal: Uber's market cap fell to ~$150B, down ~25% in six months, as investors weigh robotaxi disruption, perceiving it as a two-horse race between Waymo and Tesla — Waymo's momentum is undeniable, but Uber's scale is being undervalued in AI-driven selloff — Uber can't seem to emerge from the shadow of what's to come.
contentText:
Dan Gallagher / Wall Street Journal :

Uber's market cap fell to ~$150B, down ~25% in six months, as investors weigh robotaxi disruption and see the market as a two-horse race between Waymo and Tesla   —  Waymo's momentum is undeniable, but Uber's scale is being undervalued in AI-driven selloff  —  Uber can't seem to emerge from the shadow of what's to come.
